deviation_notes: Owner decision supersedes the e91779f game-engine-first strategy. External game-engine compatibility remains Not Assessed and is out of scope. Static public-MCP interchange is technically implemented and manually accepted at placeholder transport scope. Current uncommitted-overlay claim dacab165e0ad370136a3ac67abca4f086c21dabb8b45dcd225372b615b416ab4 covers the complete 68-file producer inventory and passes the hardened claim gate after a fresh deterministic two-root replay. Earlier diagnostic runs caught and rejected a Node-backed browser-boundary regression, an unclaimed-source inventory race, and a torso/body.root morphology alias gap before final binding. Clean-commit reachability, checkpoint note, and archive closeout remain blocked because commits are unauthorized. Novel-character visual quality, temporal runtime acceptance, atlases, theme packs, and game-engine integration are explicitly outside this acceptance.
